note: What you can say in a session (VoiceGuideView), one guide per kind of session: lifting, abs, the morning vacuums. Every line is read by backend/tests/test_voice.py through the real rules, in its state, and must come back as its intent: nothing here can stop working unnoticed.

sections.title: While you lift
sections.detail: Only these count during a set. Talk, grunt or sing along: the rest is ignored.

phrases.does: Ends the set. The camera counts it.
Ends the set with 8 reps.
Marks this set as your top set.

sections.title: Before a set
sections.detail: On the tripod, just lift: the camera starts the set.

phrases.does: Starts a set when the camera can't see you.
Makes the next set your top set.
Sets the weight.
Adds 5 lb.
Saves last time's top set from your logbook.
Switches to another day of the cycle, before the first set.

sections.title: After a set
sections.detail: The count shows on screen with where it came from. Fix it if it's wrong.

phrases.does: Fixes the last set's count.
Fixes a set you name.
Rates the last set.
Moves the last set to warm-ups.
Sends the last set's video to your coach.

sections.title: Ask
sections.detail: Every answer comes from your plan and your log.

phrases.does: The next set and its weight.
The rest left.
Sets left on this exercise, and what comes after.
The last set's count, and how it was counted.

phrases.say: what did I do last time?
phrases.does: Last time's top set.
The weight for the next set.
How close the last set was to failure, when it was measured.
Your coach's note on this exercise.
What works right now.

sections.title: Change the plan
sections.detail: Every change reaches your coach in the check-in.

phrases.does: Takes the weight your coach's rule suggests.
Keeps the weight you're on.
Skips the next set.
Moves on, and asks about any sets left.
Skips an exercise still ahead today.

sections.title: Machine taken
sections.detail: Your coach sees every swap in the check-in.

phrases.does: Keeps the rest running while you decide.
Logs the swap.
Back to the plan.

sections.title: For your coach
sections.detail: Setecho never coaches. Anything that's his call becomes a note in the check-in.

phrases.say: note for the coach: left shoulder pinched
phrases.does: Saves your words for the check-in.

phrases.say: should I go heavier next week?
phrases.does: Offers to note it for him.

sections.title: Fix and control
sections.detail: Every action is shown and said back.

phrases.does: Takes back the last action.
Replays your coach's cue for this exercise.
Answers what Setecho just asked. "No" works too.
Pauses the session. "Resume" picks it up.
Asks first, then ends it.

sections.title: Add or skip
sections.detail: Abs come after the last lift on the days your coach put them.

phrases.does: Adds them after the last lift, for today.
Takes them out of today, until you've started them.

sections.title: Rep sets
sections.detail: Leg raises and crunches count like any lift.

phrases.does: Ends the set with 12 reps.
Fixes the last set's count.
Skips the next set.

sections.title: Planks
sections.detail: Each plank starts after "three, two, one", and the next one after its rest. With Start holds automatically off, say "go".

phrases.does: Starts the next plank now.
Stops the countdown. "Resume" starts it again.
Ends the plank early and logs the time you held.
How long the last plank ran.

sections.title: Holds
sections.detail: The morning vacuums run on their own, with no camera: each hold starts after "three, two, one", and the next one after its rest.

phrases.does: Starts the next hold now.
Stops the countdown. "Resume" starts it again.
Ends a hold early and logs the time you held.
Skips the next hold.
The rest left before the next hold.
Holds left.
How long the last hold ran.

sections.title: Fix and finish
sections.detail: Every action is shown and said back.

phrases.does: Takes back the last action.

phrases.say: note for the coach: felt it in my lower back
phrases.does: Saves your words for the check-in.
Asks first, then ends it.
